title: Double Deflector Zigzag
name: double_deflector_zigzag
description: A ball is released and falls onto a left-leaning angled wall, which deflects it to the right; it then strikes a right-leaning angled wall lower down, which deflects it back to the left, zigzagging downward. Each elastic bounce loses a little speed, and the ball lands on the floor and keeps rolling to the left as the clip ends.
